title: Umuraba Wagabanyijemo Amaraso
intro: Tekereza umwuzure munini uzamuka ku butaka, Inkuge ireremba neza, n'umuntu umwe usigaye hanze ku bushake bwe. Uwo muntu yari ahambiriwe n'amaraso ku muhanuzi ariko atandukanyijwe n'imyizerere, yahamagariwe burundu kwinjira mu bwato ubwo amazi yakomezaga kwiyongera. Ese ushobora kumenya icyari inyuma y'ibyo?
clues: Ndi urubyaro rw'umwe mu bahanuzi bakomeye ba Allah, umuryango w'ukwemera nahisemo kuvamo.
Nabayeho mu gihe cy'umwuzure ukomeye, ubwo kutizera kwatwikiriye isi nk'amazi.
Nanze kwinjira mu bwato hamwe n'abizera ubwo data yampamagaye.
Navuze ko nzahungira ku musozi kugira ngo mburinde amazi.
Bambwiye ko nta kintu na kimwe cyashoboraga kurinda itegeko rya Allah kuri uwo munsi uretse imbabazi.
Narenzwe n'imiraba ndarohama, maze data abwirwa ko ntari uwo mu muryango we w'intungane.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
